pages.title: Core Item Interface
pages.text: The Protocol Core Port bridges the Protocol Core with the logistics system. It allows extracting from or inserting into the core's internal storage.$(br2)Since v1.0.2: has an independent GUI with item filtering.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Place on the side of a Protocol Core(All blocks within the protocol's core base area, except for the central block, can be destroyed). Right-click to open the GUI and set item filters — specify which items are allowed in/out.$(br2)Used with belts, it enables the Protocol Core to interact with the entire logistics network.
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
